claims: Los Hermanos Flores were the first Salvadoran and Central American artists to perform at Coachella 2026.
Los Hermanos Flores performed during the first weekend (April 10–12, 2026) at Coachella 2026.
Los Hermanos Flores are known as "Orquesta Internacional".
Los Hermanos Flores delivered their signature blend of cumbia and jazz at Coachella 2026.
Los Hermanos Flores' Coachella 2026 performance featured classic hits.
Los Hermanos Flores' Coachella 2026 performance featured engaging visuals.
Los Hermanos Flores were part of a lineup of Latino artists at the 2026 Coachella festival.
Los Hermanos Flores were scheduled to perform on the Outdoor Theatre stage at the 2026 Coachella festival.
